sources.title: Cayman Islands Film Commission: Film Rebate Programme Guidelines 2025
sources.said: 2.7. The following production categories are eligible: • Feature films (including films made for television); • Documentaries; • Scripted television series; • Unscripted (reality) television series and game shows; • Video games. … 2.10. Minimum CIQPE thresholds: • CI$250,000 across all eligible production categories. … 2.11. The Rebate is calculated as a minimum of 15% of CIQPE. 2.12. There is an uplift (additional rebate) worth 10% of CIQPE incurred on unscripted productions … 2.13. … 5% … explicitly and visibly set in the Cayman Islands. 2.14. … 5% … portray the Cayman Islands in a positive light … 2.15. … 5% … at least $1.5M in CIQPE and submit a plan for training Caymanians … 2.16. … 5% … on Cayman Brac or Little Cayman. 2.17. … 10% of CIQPE incurred on Cayman Islands resident Qualifying Local Vendors and Qualifying Local Labour … 2.18. … the maximum Rebate for any individual CIQPE is capped at 35%.

figures.finding: The minimum spend is per production, not per episode.
